tips.title: Dining and Food Delivery
tips.content: Earn 5x points at restaurants, bars, and food delivery services including Uber Eats and DoorDash. This is one of the highest dining reward rates in Canada.

tips.title: Grocery Shopping
tips.content: Earn 5x points at grocery stores. Ideal for everyday shopping at major chains like Loblaws, Sobeys, and Metro.

tips.title: Transfer to Aeroplan for Best Value
tips.content: Transfer points 1:1 to Aeroplan for flights worth up to 2+ cents per point. Book reward flights on Air Canada and Star Alliance partners.

tips.title: Combine with Amex Offers
tips.content: Stack your earnings by adding Amex Offers in the app for additional discounts at participating merchants.

tips.title: Foreign Transactions
tips.content: Avoid using this card abroad as it charges 2.5% foreign transaction fee. Use a no-FX fee card instead.
